text: What is DFS and why do many administrators avoid DFS channels?
choices: A security feature; it is slow
Dynamic Frequency Selection requires devices to vacate a channel on detecting radar; a false detection moves the access point mid-shift, and some clients have handled it badly
A power-saving mode; it reduces range
A routing protocol; it is complex
explanation: Avoiding DFS discards over half the available 5 GHz spectrum, which is a real cost. Client handling has improved substantially, and in a congested environment reconsidering the avoidance is often worthwhile.
